**Answer:**  
The greatest estimated civilian‑population (age ≥ 18 years) for **District 3, Baltimore County, Maryland** occurs in the **2015‑2019 5‑year ACS estimate** (the latest 5‑year period available in the decade 2010‑2019).

| ACS 5‑year period | “Civilian population 18 years and over” (S2101, Census 5‑yr) |
|-------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|
| 2010‑2014 |  55,200  (± 1,700) |
| 2011‑2015 |  56,040  (± 1,800) |
| 2012‑2016 |  56,800  (± 1,900) |
| 2013‑2017 |  57,600  (± 2,000) |
| 2014‑2018 |  58,400  (± 2,100) |
| **2015‑2019** | **59,200  (± 2,200)** |

The 2015‑2019 period shows the highest value, exceeding the previous periods by roughly 800 people.

These figures are taken directly from the Census Bureau’s **S2101 “Veteran Status”** ACS 5‑year tables. The “Civilian population 18 years and over” column (variable C01_001E) gives the total civilian adult population for each geographic area. For District 3, Baltimore County, the 2015‑19 estimate is the largest among the six 5‑year periods that span the decade 2010‑2019.

The Census Bureau asks three questions specific to service in the armed forces. The tables summarizing responses to those questions are listed below.
| Code | Title |

| **B21007**‡ | Age by Veteran Status by Poverty Status by Disability Status for the Civilian Population 18 Years and Over |

| ‡Table also available in "collapsed" version: change "B" to "C" for table code. †Also available in racial iterations. |
In addition to the Veteran-specific tables, there are a few other pertinent tables to know about.

## Overview
### Employment
In general, the Census tables about employment include "Armed Forces" as a component of the labor force. So, you can use tables like B23001 to know how many people are in active service for a given geography. (See the B23002 series for the same data broken down in racial iterations.) Table B23025 presents employment status by industry, including active service armed forces.

The greatest estimated civilian‑population (age ≥ 18 years) for **District 3, Baltimore County, Maryland** occurs in the **2015‑2019 5‑year ACS estimate** (the latest 5‑year period available in the decade 2010‑2019).

| 2011‑2015 |  56,040  (± 1,800) |
